name: qa-mobile
description: Mobile E2E testing: 8 skills covering native (xcuitest-suite, espresso-suite), cross-platform drivers (appium-testing, detox-testing, maestro-flows), Flutter (flutter-testing), device-matrix dispatcher (mobile-device-matrix-toolkit), and mobile accessibility (mobile-a11y-test-author). Plus 3 agents: mobile-driver-selector (picks the framework from project markers), mobile-test-scaffolder (scaffolds a project skeleton), and mobile-test-author (emits one test file per spec). For mobile-WEB viewport emulation, see playwright-testing in qa-web-e2e.
